Native SAL field assignment owns both OUStrings. Compiler Sequence lvalue views bind existing initialized pointer cells without construction/acquisition/destruction and follow real COW/realloc pointer replacement. Writer target scans borrow actual rows/fields; result, root-side-stream, failed construction and retained copies release real owners. Existing host URI/string and SAX transport, shape-error envelopes, content-type/output pairs, complete XStorage/XRelationshipAccess and DOCX/XLSX model/filter/worker/UI acceptance remain unverified or pending; no component service is fabricated.
